description.value: Your eidolon siphons time from its foes and imbues it into its allies. Choose up to 6 creatures within 30 feet of you, at least one must be an enemy and one must be an ally. Allies you target become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened 1} for 1 minute (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.summons-unleashed.Item.gqA52CsjmvHg8cnD]{Effect: Time Dilation}) and enemies you target must make a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WsUwpfmhKrKwoIe3]{slow}.
